subject: Re: Project Palisade — readout decision
body:
Team,

Decision going into Friday's Palisade readout:

1. We recommend productizing the BM25-over-training-corpus provenance path — Chiara's 200ms index is the demo. Framed as "training-data provenance v1", with TDA methods positioned as the research roadmap, not vaporware.
2. Gradient-based TDA work stops at the last-layer approximation writeup. Amara's saturation analysis goes into the readout appendix; it's the clearest justification for not burning the 5x compute.
3. Follow-on proposal for next window: closing the precision gap (0.31 is a start, not a product) via hybrid lexical+embedding scoring. Linnea drafts one slide on it.

I know BM25-wins wasn't the outcome anyone dreamed of, but a true negative at this cost is a good quarter's work. See everyone Friday.

Anders
